name: Sakurairo Prism
source:
The protagonist of this story, Hikaru Sakaki, is a second-year student at Kirigamine Private High School. Although he became the head of the photography club this spring, he finds that he is the only member of the club. As he struggles to save the club from disbandment, three girls appear before him.

What do they see behind the camera?
Each of their feelings gently overlap and create colors.

"Hey, in what color do you see me?"

(Translated from Official Site)
translation:
本作的主人公贤木光是私立雾峰高中的二年级学生。虽然今年春天他当上了摄影部部长，可部里却只剩下他一个光杆司令。正当他为了挽救濒临废部的摄影部而苦苦挣扎时，三位少女出现在了他的面前。

透过镜头，他们看到了什么？
各自的心意温柔地交叠在一起，渲染出绚丽的色彩。

“呐，在你眼里，我是什么颜色的呢？”

（译自官方网站）
